strings.text: Start making better apps
strings.original: Make an app with your coding agent

strings.text: Tell your coding agent what you want to make and try the app it builds at a public link for 24 hours. No account or install needed.
strings.original: Tell your coding agent what you want to make and try the app it builds at a public link for 24 hours. No account or install needed.

strings.text: One line for your agent which will get you up and running with the CARLOS tools to build and deploy a small app with its own database.
strings.original: Paste this line into the AI tool you use to write code. It will ask what you want to make and how it should feel, then build a small app with its own database and give you a link to try it.

strings.text: Follow the directions on https://carlosframework.com/start
strings.original: Follow the directions on https://carlosframework.com/start

strings.text: Copy
strings.original: Copy

strings.text: Copy the line for your agent
strings.original: Copy the line for your agent

strings.text: Copied
strings.original: Copied

strings.text: Copied. Paste it into your agent.
strings.original: Copied. Paste it into your agent.

strings.text: Your browser could not copy the line. It is selected. Copy it yourself.
strings.original: Your browser could not copy the line. It is selected. Copy it yourself.

strings.text: Make sure your agent has access to carlosframework.com and console.carloku.com
strings.original: Make sure your agent has access to carlosframework.com and console.carloku.com

strings.text: Paste the line and say what you want to make.
strings.original: Paste the line and say what you want to make.

strings.text: Answer a few questions about how it should look and feel. If asked, allow it to connect to one website.
strings.original: Answer a few questions about how it should look and feel. If asked, allow it to connect to one website.

strings.text: Open the link your agent gives you.
strings.original: Open the link your agent gives you.

strings.text: Your demo is public for 24 hours from when it is made. Anyone with the link can open it. Updates do not extend the 24 hours.
strings.original: Your demo is public for 24 hours from when it is made. Anyone with the link can open it. Updates do not extend the 24 hours.

strings.text: Nothing is backed up. Use made-up data. Do not enter real passwords or personal information.
strings.original: Nothing is backed up. Use made-up data. Do not enter real passwords or personal information.

strings.text: Keep it
strings.original: Keep it

strings.text: If you like it, enter your email address and the code we send. The app moves to a permanent address in a new or existing account. If you have more than one account, choose where it goes.
strings.original: If you like it, enter your email address and the code we send. The app moves to a permanent address in a new or existing account. If you have more than one account, choose where it goes.

strings.text: For a larger project or an app you already have, use an account.
strings.original: For a larger project or an app you already have, use an account.
